title: Staff Learning & Development Manager

- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays

- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

Join Zendesk as a Director of Talent Acquisition Specialist and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Director of Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong expertise in design. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities

- Modern office with great amenities

We are looking for a talented Junior Data Scientist to join our dynamic team at Cloudflare. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 9 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Power BI, Spark, PyTorch, Project Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of BAM 115,000 – BAM 170,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

- Expertise in Leadership, Communication, Analytical Thinking, Stakeholder Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: BAM 55,000 – BAM 80,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Director of PR Manager
description:

- Strong proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, Analytics, CRM
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of BAM 80,000 – BAM 115,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
